servers.name: Ranch Roleplay
servers.description: Ranch Roleplay is an English-speaking western roleplay community set in the State of Monroe around the start of the twentieth century. Its official introduction describes a custom framework, player-run businesses, properties and factions built around continuing character stories. New players complete a whitelist application and follow the community’s voice setup instructions before joining. Read the current application guide and rules on the official website.

servers.name: BadlandsRP
servers.description: A public roleplay community with persistent characters, housing, civilian jobs and whitelisted emergency-service careers. Its longstanding forum publishes server rules, civilian rights and connection guidance, supporting both everyday city life and organised stories.

servers.name: Headliner RP
servers.description: Headliner RP is DGThe99's English-speaking FiveM community for ongoing character stories in Los Santos. Current community streams include civilian businesses, emergency-service careers, judicial roles and criminal groups. The community Discord provides its support route and current joining information. Access requirements have not been independently confirmed, so read its latest rules and entry instructions before connecting. Optional queue-priority and other supporter packages are offered by the community; check the terms before purchasing.

servers.name: Royalty Roleplay
servers.description: An application-based city with character-led stories, a player economy and room for civilian businesses. Its detailed rules cover scene boundaries, medical roleplay, crime and public-service interactions, with an official application route for newcomers.

servers.name: Odyssey RP
servers.description: A public, 18+ city built around serious roleplay, player businesses and emergency-service careers. Its official site provides a clear join route and describes custom city systems with opportunities for both civilian and criminal stories.

servers.name: We The People RP
servers.description: We The People RP is an English-speaking FiveM community built around serious character roleplay in San Andreas. Explore civilian businesses and jobs, police and medical services, or longer-running criminal and gang stories. Entry requires an application and approval through its Discord. Read the current rules carefully: the city expects sustained in-character play and uses strict consequences for rule-breaking. New applicants receive staff review and can use community support for questions.

servers.name: California Roleplay (CaliRP)
servers.description: California Roleplay (CaliRP) is an English-speaking FiveM community built around vMenu. Its published server information lists police, EMS, civilian businesses, gangs, vehicles and mechanic roleplay. Access requirements are not confirmed: the website describes applications while the FiveM listing reports public access. Check the official website and Discord for current joining and department requirements.

servers.name: ProdigyRP Allowlist 4.0
servers.description: ProdigyRP Allowlist 4.0 is an English-speaking FiveM roleplay server built on the community's custom framework. It focuses on serious roleplay. Access to this allowlist server requires community approval; prospective players should read the official rules and application guidance.

servers.name: Summit RP
servers.description: Summit RP is an English-speaking FiveM community for players aged 18 and over, set in Los Santos. Explore civilian careers and businesses, emergency services, gangs and longer-running character stories. General entry is public: join its Discord, claim the Civilian role, read the rules and follow the connection guide. No application or staff approval is required for general entry.

servers.name: True Grit RP
servers.description: True Grit RP is an English-speaking RedM community for adults, built around western character stories and an economy. The team’s official introduction describes an Ozark County setting, paths for civilian and outlaw characters, and help for new roleplayers. The current listing also advertises community events. Check the verified Discord for today’s rules and joining instructions.

servers.name: State of Deliverance
servers.description: State of Deliverance is an English-speaking, adult RedM community focused on serious western character roleplay. Its current listing describes storyteller-led events, law and outlaw paths, jobs and a player economy, with an invitation for new roleplayers. The official Discord describes the same emphasis on roleplay. Read its current rules and ask about joining requirements there before connecting.

servers.name: Concrete RP
servers.description: An 18+ public city with civilian jobs, businesses and criminal groups. A published rulebook sets expectations for scene quality, player conduct and reports, with community support handled through Discord.

servers.name: Still Water RP
servers.description: Still Water RP is an English-speaking RedM community for adults that describes itself as community-led and focused on continuing stories. Its current listing includes law, medicine, native roleplay and an economy with frontier occupations. The Cfx listing links to the verified Still Water County Discord. Review the community’s rules and current joining requirements there before creating a character.

servers.name: CityLife Roleplay
servers.description: A public city founded in 2019, combining serious roleplay with a job-skill system, housing and player businesses. Police, medical and criminal stories sit alongside civilian progression, with custom systems built around a QBCore foundation.

servers.name: Syn County
servers.description: Syn County is an English-speaking RedM community for adults, with western roleplay and a player economy. The current listing identifies public access and integrated voice, while the community’s developers describe their work on the VORP framework. Join the verified Syn County Discord for the current rules and onboarding instructions before creating a character.

servers.name: District 10
servers.description: A roleplay city with an allowlist application route, civilian jobs and a strong custom-car scene. Its community website shows city life across several years and directs new players to the Discord before joining.

servers.name: Brighter Times RP 3.0
servers.description: Brighter Times RP is an established English-speaking FiveM community built around ongoing character stories, civilian businesses, emergency services and criminal roleplay. Its current 3.0 server develops the community through a mix of everyday careers and organised group activities. New players request whitelist approval through the community Discord before joining. Players looking for a long-term home can read the current rules and application instructions there. Supporter purchases are available; check their terms and the community rules before deciding whether this is the right fit.

servers.name: Ebonridge
servers.description: Ebonridge is an English-speaking RedM community for adults that combines frontier life with supernatural character stories. Cfx’s July 2026 community feature describes a world of humans and hidden supernatural identities, supported by player events and continuing stories. Its current listing confirms a serious supernatural roleplay focus. Join the verified community Discord to review the lore, rules and current application requirements.

servers.name: HighLife Roleplay
servers.description: A long-running city built around civilian work, emergency services and criminal progression. Its public guide and player wiki explain how to get started and how everyday mechanics work, giving newcomers a clearer path into the community.

servers.name: RosalitaRP
servers.description: RosalitaRP is an English-speaking western roleplay community for adults set in 1899. Its public rules require whitelisting and focus on believable character choices, consent boundaries and an economy shaped by players. The community also describes permadeath mechanics, so prospective players should read the full rules before applying. Its current RedM record exposes the RSG framework.

servers.name: EchoRP
servers.description: A character-focused city with an application process, a detailed gang handbook and rules centred on believable stories. Civilian careers, criminal groups and emergency services share an economy where relationships and consequences matter.

servers.name: Vital RP
servers.description: An 18+ whitelisted city that describes its style as semi-serious and story-first. Civilian businesses, police and criminal groups all have space in a community focused on continuing character stories rather than isolated encounters.

servers.name: Medieval RP
servers.description: Medieval RP uses RedM for a medieval setting where players build characters around social standing, ambition and consequences. The community’s published rules describe serious roleplay for adults, with voice interaction and an emphasis on story before conflict. This offers a different setting from the usual western frontier. Read the current rules and joining instructions through the official community links.

servers.name: Dust to Dreams RP
servers.description: Dust to Dreams RP is an English-speaking RedM community for adults focused on serious western roleplay. Its current community listing describes civilian businesses and jobs alongside law and medical characters, and explicitly directs new players to apply through Discord. The verified Discord identifies the same western roleplay community. Read its current rules and application guidance before joining.

servers.name: Everfall
servers.description: An established 18+ city with detailed roleplay rules, practical newcomer guides and a range of civilian, emergency-service and criminal paths. Players can begin with contract work, join a business or apply to a public-service department, while the community provides reporting and support channels for problems. The community also offers optional paid content; check its current rules and joining guide before playing.

servers.name: LiquidRP
servers.description: An application-based city with clear rules for businesses, organisations and everyday interactions. New players complete a rulebook-based application and character backstory, while published guides explain how to participate and how to report problems.

servers.name: The Tackroom
servers.description: An 18+ equestrian sandbox with optional roleplay, custom horses and tack, ranch building, cattle herding and community events. Train and trade horses, build a homestead or explore slice-of-life activities at your own pace. Join the official Discord, answer the short whitelist questions and wait for staff approval before connecting. Optional paid support includes some housing eligibility and activity perks.

servers.name: Lucid City Roleplay
servers.description: A public city offering civilian work, housing, player businesses and criminal missions. The community combines custom city content with police, medical and justice roles, with updates and support organised through its forum and Discord.

servers.name: Gilded Roleplay
servers.description: Gilded Roleplay is an English-speaking RedM community for adults with a serious western setting. Its current listing describes a 1904 world with criminal story opportunities, while the official website provides rules and a detailed getting-started guide. New players complete an in-game entry quiz on their first login. Follow the official Discord for current admission and voice-setup instructions.

servers.name: Isles RP
servers.description: An allowlisted, beginner-friendly roleplay community with a focus on creative characters and collaborative stories. Its public community guide and social links introduce the city, while civilian businesses, organisations and emergency services offer different ways to participate.

servers.name: Western Skies Roleplay
servers.description: Western Skies Roleplay is an English-speaking RedM community for adults set in 1901. Its detailed player handbook explains a character-driven economy, player businesses, frontier work and law and medical roles. The guide requires a microphone and tells newcomers to unlock access through the community Discord before joining. Read the current handbook and full rules to prepare a character.

servers.name: Space Turtles Roleplay Europe
servers.description: The European public city from Space Turtles Roleplay, combining jobs, businesses and criminal progression. Community support and development discussions are centred in the official Discord, with a long-running public-server identity.

servers.name: Starlight Community Roleplay
servers.description: Starlight Community Roleplay is an English-speaking FiveM community for players aged 18 and over. Its persistent city supports civilian careers, businesses, police and fire or medical services, alongside criminal character stories. Entry requires an application and approval through the official Discord. Read its current rules before joining: the community expects sustained character roleplay and limits repetitive combat and harassment. The website provides current rules, support links and a ban-appeal route.

servers.name: GTA World English
servers.description: GTA World is an English-speaking, text-based roleplay community focused on lasting characters and everyday life in Los Santos. Players build stories through civilian jobs, businesses, government, emergency services and criminal factions. The community moved to FiveM in August 2026 and uses its own developed game systems. Joining requires an accepted application, so read the official rules and onboarding guide before connecting. This is mature GTA roleplay with detailed conduct and consent rules; it is a slower, writing-led experience rather than a voice-chat server.

servers.name: BritishRP
servers.description: BritishRP brings serious British-themed roleplay to a TMC-based FiveM city, with civilian careers, businesses, emergency services and criminal characters. To join, enter the community Discord, read the rules and submit a whitelist application for approval. The public rulebook explains roleplay terms, harassment protections, sensitive-scene boundaries and where to report problems. Start with the current application guide and rules on the community website.

servers.name: Popcorn Roleplay
servers.description: A public community combining serious character roleplay with a player-run economy and businesses. Its detailed rulebook covers respectful conduct, scene context and player interactions, while the official community thread documents development over several years.

servers.name: Highwater Roleplay 2.0
servers.description: Highwater Roleplay 2.0 is an English-speaking RedM community for adults with a focus on character-led western stories. The community’s own introduction describes serious roleplay, while the current listing highlights economy and crime as parts of the setting. Its current Cfx record exposes RSG. Use the verified Highwater Discord for the latest rules and joining instructions.

servers.name: Stoneworks
servers.description: Stoneworks is an English-speaking Minecraft community built around player-created nations, diplomacy, warfare and worldbuilding. Players can establish governments, build settlements, trade and shape ongoing political stories. Its official introduction welcomes both casual and serious participants; PvP matters during wars, while professions, economy and roleplay offer other ways to take part. Follow the official website and Discord for current joining instructions and rules. The displayed count covers the advertised network, including its lobby and other worlds.

servers.name: FREE2RP 2.0
servers.description: FREE2RP 2.0 is an English-speaking FiveM community for players aged 18 and over, with character-led stories across civilian businesses, emergency services, the justice system and criminal crews. Players must apply and be approved before joining. Its public rules set expectations for roleplay, personal boundaries and reporting, and its moderation policy describes coaching, escalating penalties and appeals. Read the current rules and joining guidance on the official website. Application review can take time, and optional paid packages offer faster review and queue priority without guaranteeing approval.

servers.name: The Rift Trails
servers.description: The Rift Trails is an English-speaking RedM equestrian sandbox for adults aged 18 and over. Its international community offers trail rides, horse shows, player clubs, custom equestrian facilities and organised events. Character roleplay is optional: players can join roleplay-led activities or enjoy the horse-focused sandbox without compulsory in-character rules. Join the official Discord, read the community guidance and complete its verification steps before connecting. The precise approval requirement is not confirmed.

servers.name: Onyx County
servers.description: Onyx County is an English-speaking western roleplay community set in 1901, with civilian work, ranching, player-run businesses, law enforcement and medical roles. Its public newcomer guides explain character creation, earning a living, housing and finding help. The rules set expectations for serious roleplay, consent and reporting; some careers and businesses have their own applications. Follow the official getting-started guide and Discord announcements before joining.

servers.name: Everglade County RP
servers.description: Everglade County RP is an English-speaking RedM community for adults set in an 1899 bayou frontier. Its official site provides rules, laws, public records and an onboarding guide, with character paths in law, medicine, justice, railways, business and ranching. The guide sends players through Discord whitelist steps and links the same server code. Read the current rules before joining.

servers.name: State of Fremont 1902
servers.description: State of Fremont 1902 is an English-speaking RedM community for adults that welcomes new roleplayers. Its verified Discord describes a setting shaped by character decisions, law and ongoing stories. The current listing includes civilian businesses, housing and ranching alongside courts and outlaw roles. Review its current rules and joining requirements in the official Discord before creating a character.

servers.name: Roleplay UK
servers.description: Build a character in Roleplay UK’s British-themed FiveM world, with civilian jobs, businesses, emergency services and criminal stories. General entry is public; police and NHS careers have separate applications. The official wiki covers the starter tutorial, jobs, voice setup, reporting and connection help. Read the current rules before joining, including the community’s reporting deadlines and appeal requirements.

servers.name: Resilient Roleplay
servers.description: An 18+ English-speaking community focused on long-form character stories, player-run businesses and a working police, medical and justice system. Civilian jobs include mechanics, towing, electrical work and fishing. Joining requires a whitelist application; the published rules cover consent, harassment, meaningful roleplay and protection for newcomer and medical areas. Optional paid benefits include application and queue priority, extra character slots and approved custom characters.

servers.name: Wild Haven Roleplay
servers.description: A whitelisted UK city built around grounded characters and serious scenes. Civilian businesses, police, medical and fire roles share an emphasis on believable driving, consequences and giving other players room to develop their stories.

servers.name: MassiveCraft
servers.description: MassiveCraft is an English-speaking Minecraft Java community combining fantasy roleplay with factions survival. Its setting supports player groups, settlements, trade and shared stories, with guidance available through the community Discord. The official store describes roleplay and factions as the server focus and publishes its support policies. Check the community website and Discord for current joining requirements and client versions. The displayed player count covers the advertised network and may include survival, lobby or other activity beyond a specific RP scene.

servers.name: Lord of the Craft
servers.description: Lord of the Craft is an English-speaking medieval fantasy roleplay community on Minecraft Java Edition. Players create original characters, join nations and develop stories within a shared setting. Its published roleplay standards cover character conduct and collaborative storytelling, and new players complete a whitelist application before joining. Read the current rules and application guide on the official website. The displayed player count covers the advertised Minecraft network, including any lobby and other worlds.

servers.name: CMG Roleplay
servers.description: A British and European public community with civilian jobs, police roles, criminal groups and community events. Its wiki explains basic controls and city systems, making the first steps into the server accessible.

servers.name: Souvenir Trails RP
servers.description: Souvenir Trails RP is an English-speaking RedM community whose official introduction emphasizes beginner support and community-driven western stories. It describes player homes, camps, businesses and medical and law roles, with partial controller support and integrated voice. A later community post announced the server opening. Join its verified Discord for the current allowlist steps and rules.

servers.name: Fat Duck Gaming
servers.description: An Australian roleplay community with extensive guides for civilian jobs, activities and public-service careers. Its rules require characters to stay in character and give conflicts believable reasons, supporting a mix of everyday city life and longer stories.

servers.name: ECLIPSE Roleplay
servers.description: ECLIPSE Roleplay is an established English-speaking community for structured voice roleplay in Los Santos. Players build ongoing characters through civilian work, businesses, emergency services, government and criminal stories. Founded in 2017, the community moved to FiveM in 2026 and develops its own game systems. New players complete a roleplay quiz and staff review before playing. Its detailed rules cover character conduct, reporting and consent for mature scenes. Read the official joining guide and rules first; the community is still refining the experience after its recent move to FiveM.

servers.name: BlueBirdRP
servers.description: An Australian city inspired by Victoria and Melbourne. Players can begin with everyday civilian jobs, build experience towards emergency-service or business roles, or develop a criminal character within the community guidelines.

servers.name: Hydrate
servers.description: Set in Los Santos, Hydrate is an Australian FiveM community for civilian life, businesses, emergency services, justice and criminal stories. Its getting-started guide walks new players through Discord verification and connecting, with no general whitelist application. Players must be at least 16, while characters must be 18 or older. The community publishes detailed player-boundary rules, reporting instructions and an appeals process; check its current rules and joining guide before playing.

servers.name: San Andreas Department of Roleplay (SADRP)
servers.description: SADRP is an English-speaking FiveM community centred on vMenu, believable character stories and organised emergency-service departments. Civilian players can build everyday scenes and businesses, while police and fire positions have their own application and training process. Its public documentation covers character development, consent in roleplay and staff approval for larger scenarios. Check the community website and Discord for current general joining requirements before connecting.

servers.name: Legit RP
servers.description: Legit RP is an English-speaking FiveM community for players aged 18 and over. Its city brings together character stories, player-run businesses, emergency services and criminal roleplay. Entry requires an application and approval. Read the community rules and current application guidance before joining, and use its Discord support tickets for help.

servers.name: San Andreas Valley Roleplay
servers.description: A realism-focused community with detailed rules for character behaviour, injuries and scene consequences. Its official site describes civilian careers, a law-enforcement academy, fire and medical services, and a legal system supporting longer character stories.

servers.name: The Academy Roleplay — Ambassador
servers.description: The Academy Roleplay is an English-speaking FiveM community associated with Officer Messer, with ongoing police, civilian and emergency-service stories. This listing follows the Ambassador server. The community provides step-by-step joining guidance, and its creators direct newcomers to the Officer Messer Discord for current entry instructions. Broader Academy guidance describes an application process, but the exact current Ambassador requirements have not been confirmed. Read the community rules and joining instructions before connecting.

servers.name: Everyday Roleplay
servers.description: Everyday Roleplay offers serious British roleplay in a TMC-based FiveM city, with civilian careers, player-run businesses, emergency services and organised criminal stories. Its public rules ask players to support newcomers, leave room for fair responses in scenes and report problems through staff channels. The FAQ covers setup and where to ask for help. Check the Discord joining instructions before connecting; application requirements have not yet been confirmed.

servers.name: Westhaven: The Hush RP
servers.description: Westhaven: The Hush RP is an English-speaking, allowlisted RedM community for players aged 21 and over. Its official lore describes a supernatural frontier where hidden identities, magic and the aftermath of the rising dead shape character stories. Published worldbuilding covers human and supernatural paths, law and medicine. Read the current lore and community rules before applying through Discord.

servers.name: The Frontier Roleplay
servers.description: The Frontier Roleplay is an English-speaking, allowlisted RedM community for adults set in 1913. Its public listing describes western character roleplay across frontier communities, and the matching Discord identifies it as a serious roleplay server. Review the community’s current rules, character expectations and allowlist process in Discord before joining.

servers.name: Circuit RP Public
servers.description: The public city from Circuit Roleplay, with an emphasis on character interaction and stories. Its community provides rules, guides and support alongside a separate application-based instance; this listing represents the public server only.

servers.name: San Andreas County Roleplay
servers.description: An English-speaking vMenu community with public civilian and community-officer roleplay, structured emergency-service departments, player businesses and certified gangs. The county also supports car meets, racing and social activities, with published scene-consent rules, support tickets and an appeals route. Some departments require applications. Optional paid perks include gameplay privileges, so review the current rules and store before joining.
